test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work alone in 30 days. B is 25% less efficient than A, while C is 33(1)/(3)\% more efficient than B. In how many days can A, B and C, working together, complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work alone in 30 days. B is 25% less efficient than A, while C is 33(1)/(3)\% more efficient than B.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of A be 4a

So, efficiency of B = 4a × 75%

⇒ 3a

Efficiency of C = 3a × 4/3

⇒ 4a

Now,

Total work = 30 × 4a

⇒ 120a

Time taken by them = (120a)/(11a)

⇒ (120)/(11)

**∴ A, B and C can, complete the work in (120)/(11) days oworking together**
